title: Exterior signage

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Adapt a message to building divisions so pedestrians can identify the store and read the promise at a distance.
strategic_value: Color bands and large lifestyle images can make the Cox storefront recognizable along two elevations.
demonstration: A corner storefront combines the mounted Cox sign with photo panels and colored message strips across its glazing.
practical_value: Check the reading order around a corner and place key words where mullions will not interrupt them.

content_islands.name: Building identity
content_islands.spec: Retain the mounted Cox names on the solid walls flanking the glazed corner.

content_islands.name: Window bands
content_islands.spec: Run photos and short message fragments across the upper windows, alternating turquoise and purple bands.
